notes: The Edges tab now says when your own light-check answer is what set the edges grade, and links to where you change it.
Looks fine by eye isn't offered on a scan where the card's edge wasn't found (a dark border on the black lid): those aren't the card's real corners.
A centering line found at only a few spots along its border (artwork or text that looks like a line) no longer counts against the grade; the result says which line to check in the Centering tab.
